-- 20261002000000_org_audit_summary — per-action counts of an org's audit trail, for the
-- admin dashboard's activity card.
--
-- APPLIED HISTORY, NOT DESIRED STATE. Append-only like every other migration here.
--
-- WHY A DEFINER FUNCTION. Schema `audit` grants USAGE to no client role, so no
-- authenticated caller reads audit.events by any route; public.org_audit_events is the
-- one read path, and it returns rows, not counts. This is its sibling, with the same
-- owner (app_audit_reader, a NOLOGIN role holding SELECT and nothing else) and the same
-- rule: `_org` is a selector, not an authorization. The SELECT policy on audit.events
-- (rank >= 30, evaluated with the caller's identity still resolving through the JWT
-- claims) decides what is counted, so naming an org the caller does not administer
-- counts nothing. The window is clamped to 90 days, because a caller-supplied window is
-- a caller-supplied amount of work.
-- SOURCE: docs/adr/20260202-audit-trail.md (the trail's read path)
CREATE FUNCTION public.org_audit_summary(_org uuid, _since timestamptz DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS TABLE (action text, events bigint)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $summary$
  SELECT e.action, pg_catalog.count(*)
    FROM audit.events e
   WHERE e.org_id = _org
     AND e.occurred_at >= greatest(
       coalesce(_since, pg_catalog.now() - interval '30 days'),
       pg_catalog.now() - interval '90 days'
     )
   GROUP BY e.action
   ORDER BY e.action;
$summary$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.org_audit_summary(uuid, timestamptz) OWNER TO app_audit_reader;
-- PostgreSQL grants EXECUTE to PUBLIC on every new function and Supabase's default
-- privileges add anon, so a definer function that names no revoke is callable by an
-- unauthenticated caller. Both go first; then the one client grant the allowlist
-- entry authorizes.
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.org_audit_summary(uuid, timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.org_audit_summary(uuid, timestamptz) FROM anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.org_audit_summary(uuid, timestamptz) TO authenticated;
